description: This PHP file defines a class 'MeetingsListViewSmarty' extending another class 'ListViewSmarty'. It customizes the building of an export link for the meetings list view in the SuiteCRM application, generating HTML for export and map links with JavaScript event handlers.

classes.name: MeetingsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A class that extends ListViewSmarty to customize the list view for meetings, specifically adding export and map links.
